task: Roll back the current deployment after a critical bug was detected in production. Token budget is critically low.

candidate_memories.content: Rollback sequence is strictly ordered: (1) shift traffic to previous version via load balancer weight change, (2) confirm health checks pass on previous version, (3) scale down the failed version, (4) post incident message in #incident channel. Skipping step 2 before step 3 risks complete service outage if the previous version is not healthy.
Previous version image tag is available as the PREV_IMAGE_TAG env var in the deployment pipeline.
All rollbacks must be followed by a blameless post-mortem within 48 h.
